title: Sr Advocate / Advocates
description:
WANTED: ADVOCATES READY TO LEAD IN COURT

Assured Justice LLP

Openings in Hosur & Shoolagiri - Krishnagiri District Tamil Nadu

For a litigator, a true practice is built in the trenches—in the trial courts, through rigorous cross-examinations, and in direct client counsel. Assured Justice LLP is bringing the scale, technology, and rigorous standards of a premier national firm to the dynamic legal markets of Hosur and Shoolagiri.

We are not looking for juniors to carry files, fetch pass-overs, or watch from the sidelines. We are looking for advocates with fire in them to take complete, end-to-end ownership of their matters.

The Opportunity & Responsibilities

* Total File Ownership: From the first client conference to the final order, you are the face of the file. You will draft, file, argue, and negotiate. No shadow work. Your name will appear on the memo of parties, and your reputation will be yours to build.
* Trial to Appellate Advocacy: Get on your feet immediately. You will manage a heavy, diverse docket spanning local civil property disputes, partition suits, matrimonial proceedings, criminal litigation, and labour law, while also collaborating on constitutional and commercial briefs before the High Courts.
* Impeccable Drafting Standards: You will be mentored to produce pleadings, written submissions, and legal notices that command judicial respect. Expect a practice culture that demands rigorous statutory validation, exact volume and page number citation verification, and absolute precision in drafting.
* Direct Client Relationships: Build and retain your own client network. We expect you to conduct independent client conferences, establish clear financial engagements, and become the trusted legal advisor for local families, businesses, and institutions.

The Platform: Assured Justice LLP We are a technology-driven law firm executing an ambitious expansion to 30 offices across India within 36 months. Our Hosur and Shoolagiri branch offices are fully integrated with our headquarters in Bengaluru and our broader network spanning Chennai, Cochin, Trivandrum, Mysore, and Belgaum.

Practicing here means getting the intensive, grassroots trial experience of a mofussil court system, fully backed by the resources, modern tech-enabled platforms, and multi-jurisdictional exposure of a rapidly scaling firm.

Who Should Apply? The challenge is real. The hours are demanding, and our standards for legal research and presentation are absolute. If you have the appetite for ownership and the ambition to grow into a complete, independent litigator, there is no better canvas.

To Apply: Submit your CV alongside a brief writing sample (a drafted pleading, petition, or legal notice) to rm@assuredjustice.com.

Contact: +91 9739206710

Website: www.assuredjustice.com

title: Associate Lawyer
description:
We're hiring: Associate, Office of the Managing Partner | Chennai
| Coimbatore

Most associate roles give you one practice area and a long wait before you see how a firm is really built.

This one puts you next to the Managing Partner & CEO from day one.

You'll work on legal matters across practice areas, and also on what it takes to grow a law firm: strategy, operations, technology and new initiatives. We're looking for a lawyer who thinks from first principles, uses AI as a serious professional tool, and delivers without needing to be supervised.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Research, analyse and draft opinions, memos, contracts, pleadings and notices across corporate, real estate, disputes, IP and white collar matters

• Run matters from start to finish, taking more ownership as you grow

• Use AI research and drafting tools daily, and check every output with your own legal judgment

• Build precedents, templates, playbooks and AI workflows the whole firm will use

• Work directly with the Managing Partner on firm-building projects: operations, process improvement, technology and business development

YOU'RE RIGHT FOR THIS IF YOU

• Understand legal concepts deeply, not just the case law around them

• Write and speak clear, precise, persuasive English

• Are fluent with AI tools and know where they go wrong

• Take an outcome and deliver it with minimal supervision

• Are curious about how law firms are run as businesses, not just about the law

WHO SHOULD APPLY

• Lawyers with 0–3 years of post-qualification experience

• Final-year LL.B. students graduating in 2027: outstanding candidates will receive pre-placement offers

WHAT YOU GET

• Daily mentoring from the Managing Partner & CEO

• Variety few associates see this early: legal, strategic and operational work

• Real responsibility and fast growth for those who deliver

• Competitive pay, linked to performance

Location: Chennai (in office)

HOW TO APPLY

Email your CV to vidya@lawindia.com, copying vs@lawindia.com

Subject: Associate – Office of the MP

In your email, make your case in 150 words: why are you the most suitable person for this role? We'll read this before your CV.

title: Associate III - AML KYC Specialist
description:
**Role Description**
**Overview of Role/Principle Responsibilities:**
To act as subject matter expert on all core AML/KYC due diligence activities, perform robust quality assurance and handle advanced cases, directly supporting the Analysts and providing hands-on guidance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Advanced Due Diligence Execution

Complex Entity Review: Review and perform due diligence on non-standard, complex structures (e.g., layered ownership, trusts, foundations, offshore vehicles), ensuring full transparency of control and beneficial ownership.
  
  
Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead EDD work on high-risk clients (e.g., PEPs, complex private equity structures, high-risk geographies):
  
  
Analyse and corroborate sources of wealth and funds through documentary evidence and public record checks
  
  
Conduct in-depth open-source investigations on high-risk profiles or negative media hits
  
  
Liaise with customer agreed escalation point for enhanced approval and/or further escalation
  
  

* Screening and Risk Mitigation

Name Screening Oversight: Validate name screening s escalated by Analysts, determine false positives and true matches, and make decisions on further escalation.
  
  
Sanctions/Adverse Media: Investigate and document all genuine matches against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media lists, with clear escalation narratives and recommendations.
  
  

* Risk Assessment & Rating

Risk Factor Analysis: Review risk ratings assigned by Analysts, ensure scoring methodologies are correctly applied, and correct or re-assess where necessary.
  
  
KYC Reviews: Lead periodic reviews of investor files. Re-assess documentation based on trigger events—ownership changes, negative news, jurisdiction upgrade/downgrade, etc.
  
  

* Quality Control and Training

File Review: Execute rigorous file quality checks. Maintain QA checklists, document deficiencies, and confirm corrective action by Analysts.
  
  
Coaching: Provide hands-on coaching and process clarification to Analysts and act as the first point of contact for technical queries.
  
  
Knowledge Sharing: Develop guidance notes, training materials, and best practice documentation for use within the team.
  
  

* Analysis and Implementation

Procedure Updates: Monitor changes in AML/CFT internal procedures as required. Provide operational input to Team Leaders regarding impacts on workflows.
  
  
Project Participation: Support remediation, data clean-up, or regulatory project work as assigned.
  
  

* Casework & Escalation

Complex Query Resolution: Act as initial escalation point for complex or unusual cases—either resolve or clearly summarise and escalate to Team Leader/Manager.
  
  
Investor & Counterparty Liaison: Handle detailed, technical queries from investors, fund managers, or distributors related to AML/KYC requirements.
  
  

* Know your distribution (KYD) – where applicable
* In-Depth Questionnaire Analysis: Review DDQ and Wolfsberg Questionnaire responses in detail, cross-checking answers for plausibility and completeness. Follow up directly with intermediaries if clarifications are needed.
* AML Control Framework Assessment: Conduct a review and summarise the distributor’s or platform’s Financial Crime (FC) control policies and procedures, including initial and ongoing client due diligence processes. Prepare a comparison of intermediaries’ stated practices against client’s risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
* Reliance Assessment Support: Assess whether reliance on the intermediary’s AML controls may be considered, and document the findings. Where Placement Agents are involved, assist in determining if they fulfil a different role and escalate uncertainties to the designated client function.
* Investor Profile Review: Analyse and document who the underlying investors are (retail, HNWI, professional clients, etc.), as disclosed by the distributor or obtained via DDQ.
* Quality Assurance: Review Analysts’ KYD files for thoroughness and escalate deficiencies or high-risk findings as required.

**Skills And Behaviours Required**

* 5-6 years’ AML/KYC experience with focus on alternative investments and complex structures
* Demonstrable expertise in risk-based approaches, screening investigations, and EDD
* Adept communicator, able to articulate complex regulatory topics in practical terms
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and coaching ability
* High proficiency in KYC/AML databases and screening tools Proficiency with office productivity tools; prior exposure to KYC/AML systems advantageous.
* Strong interpersonal skills and team focus

**Skills**
Anti-Money Laundering, Attention to Detail, Time Management

title: Engineering Manager – Permitting & Regulatory Compliance
description:
**Job Description**
Remarkable people, trusted by clients to design and advance the world.
  
  
Wood is currently recruiting for an Engineering Manager – Permitting & Regulatory Compliance to be based in our Chennai, India Office.
  
  
This position will be for a permanent role supporting our major clients.
  
  
**The Role**
The Engineering Manager – Permitting & Regulatory Compliance is a core member within the Wood India Project Management group. This role has a remit across all project phases relating to securing applicable regulatory permits and statutory approvals applied by the Owner, which are essential to design, engineer, construct, store hazardous materials, and safely start up the plant in full compliance with the applicable with all legal and statutory requirements within the industry.
  
  
**What We Can Offer**

* Meaningful and interesting projects delivered to high profile clients across the Energy Sector
* Flexible working arrangements that balance client, team and individual needs offering hybrid and remote working where relevant
* Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business
* Competitive renumeration package with regular reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market
* Commitment to continued professional development; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests
* Global connections: join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession
* Energy Transition Academy; join a community of experts sharing your knowledge and gaining more exposure to a variety of existing and emerging energy systems – delivered by experts in their field

**Responsibilities**

* FEED, Detailed Engineering and PMC Support phases:

**Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) Phase**
During the FEED phase, this role provides strategic regulatory foresight to ensure early-stage designs are fundamentally compliant.
  
  

* Support Engineering & Design Teams: Review preliminary layouts, process flow diagrams (PFDs), and plot plans to ensure early-stage designs incorporate correct safety distances and environmental zone restrictions.
* Provide Client Advisory Support: Advise the Client on the comprehensive list of applicable Indian statutory approvals, estimated timelines, and documentation requirements needed for their upcoming project lifecycle.
* Participate in Model reviews to ascertain that the design is compliant with all statutory norms.

**Detailed Engineering (DE) Phase**
During the DE phase, the focus shifts to vetting technical data and verifying that the final, granular designs strictly adhere to Indian statutory codes
  
  

* Support Engineering & Design Teams: Conduct rigorous reviews of detailed engineering drawings, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), equipment datasheets, and layouts to verify full alignment with Indian standards
* Provide Client Advisory Support: Package and hand over thoroughly vetted technical documentation to the Client, providing clear technical explanations to assist them in preparing their formal applications.
* Regulatory Alignment Vetting: Review contractor and vendor designs for specialized units (like ETP, STP, and hazardous chemical storage) to ensure they meet the technical criteria mandated by regulatory bodies like the SPCB and PESO.

**Project Management Consultancy (PMC) Phase**
In the PMC phase, the role acts as the Owners Engineer, monitoring contractor compliance and provide technical support to the Client
  
  

* Support Engineering & Design Teams: Cross-functional coordination between the EPC contractors and the design team to ensure field modifications or site queries (RFIs) do not breach statutory guidelines.
* Provide Client Advisory Support: Provide ongoing guidance to the Client on the health and progress of the Permit Master Schedule, highlighting potential milestone risks, bottlenecks, or regulatory changes.
* Advisory Monitoring: Track and review the documentation prepared by EPC contractors for construction-stage consents (like Consent to Establish), ensuring it is technically sound before the Client submits and expedites it with the respective authorities.

**General**

* Guide the Owner and EPC contractors systematically through the entire government approval lifecycle from initial engineering design to final plant commissioning.
* Establish, maintain, and dynamically update a comprehensive Permit Master Schedule to strictly track timelines, avoiding project milestone delays or regulatory fines.
* Review and vet technical engineering drawings, layouts, and technical data sheets from contractors to verify full alignment with Indian statutory standards prior to official submission.
* Awareness of State Factory Inspectorate (DISSH) and Labor Department compliance
* Acts as a SME and provide technical advisory support.
* Pollution Control & Environmental Compliance (PCB & MoEFCC)
* Lead the processing and tracking to secure formal Environmental Clearance (EC) from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) for greenfield layouts or brownfield expansions.
* Obtain mandatory Consent to Establish (CTE) before construction mobilization and Consent to Operate (CTO) prior to plant commissioning from the respective State Pollution Control Board (PCB).
* Secure the required Hazardous Waste Authorization from the PCB under the provisions of the Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules.
* Evaluate plant designs for Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP) and Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) to confirm engineering alignment with Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) or specified state treated discharge standards.
* Storage, Safety & Explosives (PESO & OISD)
* Obtain crucial statutory approvals and operating licenses from the Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organization (PESO) for layout, construction, and bulk storage of petroleum, gases, and hazardous chemicals under the Petroleum Rules and Gas Cylinder Rules.
* Ensure overall plant safety layout designs, separation distances, and mitigation frameworks strictly adhere to Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD) standards and guidelines.
* Secure Factory Plan Approvals and operational factory licenses from the State Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) or Inspectorate of Factories.
* Mechanical & Electrical Utilities (Boiler Act & Electrical Inspectorate)
* Coordinate registrations, drawings approval, and stage-wise physical inspections for all high-pressure boilers and steam piping networks under the provisions of The Indian Boilers Act, 1923.
* Secure mandatory statutory clearances from the Chief Electrical Inspector to Government (CEIG) for the installation and energization of electrical substations, transformers, switchyards, and plant lightning protection infrastructure under Central Electricity Authority (CEA) norms.
* Radiation & Nuclear Safety (AERB)
* Secure necessary procurement permissions and operating licenses from the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) for industrial radiography equipment, nuclear level gauges, and radiation-emitting equipment utilized in non-destructive testing (NDT) or plant instrumentation systems.

**Qualifications**
**What makes you remarkable?**
At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.
  
  
**Expected**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or mechanical engineering or Petroleum Engineering
  
  
**Experience:**
Minimum of 20+ years of demonstrated professional experience managing statutory permitting, regulatory clearances, and utility compliance for mega industrial projects (Chemical plants, Refineries, Petrochemical complexes, or oil and gas facilities).
  
  
**Role Exposure:**
Prior experience working within a Plant Owner/ EPC Contractor /Engineering Consultant companies is essential.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications & Additional Qualifications**

* ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems (EMS) Lead Auditor / Implementation Certification.
* ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems Certification.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Comprehensive Regulatory Fluency: Thorough operational understanding of Indian statutory laws and acts governing industrial production, environmental protection (PCB rules), utility infrastructure safety (Boiler Act, CEIG norms), hazardous chemical management (PESO, OISD standards), and specialized nuclear/radiation instrumentation guidelines (AERB regulations) and any other Indian regulatory laws as applicable.
* Stakeholder Liaison & Communication: Excellent inter-personal, negotiation, and verbal/written communication capabilities to clearly articulate complex engineering plant parameters to regulatory officers and coordinate seamlessly across cross-functional multi-disciplinary project teams.

**About Us**
Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

title: Associate Director, Employment Counsel
description:

Up to 10%

**What You Will Do**
Serve as the primary legal advisor on employment law matters affecting the Company's operations in India, providing practical, risk-based guidance to Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, business leaders, and other stakeholders.
  
  

* Monitor, analyze, and communicate developments in Indian labor and employment laws, regulations, and court decisions, including emerging requirements under the Labour Codes and other employment-related legislation.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain employment-related agreements and documents, including offer letters, employment agreements, restrictive covenant agreements, separation documents, contractor agreements, and employment policies.

* Partner with HR and business leaders to support workforce initiatives, organizational changes, restructurings, policy implementation, and compliance programs.
* Conduct legal research and provide clear, actionable recommendations on complex or novel employment law issues.

title: Technical Compliance Specialist - Ops Centre
description:
**Location Country**
India
  
  
**Work Location**
Chennai
  
  
**Who are V?**
As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals - people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Overall Purpose of The Job**

* The Technical Compliance Specialist is responsible for supporting the effective monitoring of technical compliance across managed vessels within the Operations Support Centre (OSC).
* The role ensures vessels maintain high standards of technical reliability, preventive maintenance, and regulatory compliance through structured monitoring of defects, maintenance routines, inspection findings, vessel certification, and technical reporting. In addition to compliance oversight, the role supports ship management teams in coordinating key class surveys, statutory services, and class-related compliance matters to ensure vessels remain fully compliant with classification society requirements, statutory regulations, and company standards.
* Through proactive monitoring, analysis, and coordination with ship management teams, the Technical Compliance Specialist contributes to maintaining fleet technical readiness and reducing operational and regulatory risks.

**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**Technical Compliance Monitoring**

* Monitor defect management across assigned vessels and highlight critical or overdue defects to the Ship Management team for timely resolution.
* Monitor compliance with critical spare parts requirements to ensure vessel reliability and operational readiness.
* Monitor adherence to critical planned maintenance routines and ensure timely execution onboard.
* Conduct oversight of routine planned maintenance activities to ensure maintenance schedules are followed.

**Inspection & Findings Monitoring**

* Monitor Vessel Inspection Reports (VIR) and track progress on corrective actions.
* Monitor findings raised by Inspection Managers and ensure timely follow-up and closure.
* Identify overdue or recurring findings and escalate where required.

**Certification & Regulatory Compliance**

* Monitor the validity and compliance status of vessel trading certificates.
* Monitor PMS-related certification to ensure system compliance with company and statutory requirements.
* Track and monitor outstanding Conditions of Class (CoC) and support timely closure.

**Survey & Class Compliance Coordination**

* In addition to monitoring responsibilities, the Technical Compliance Specialist supports ship management teams in coordinating key class and statutory compliance activities, including:
* Supporting the planning and coordination of Class Annual Surveys.
* Assisting with the planning and arrangement of Underwater Inspections (UWI).
* Assisting in the application and follow-up of Conditions of Class (CoC) and dispensation requests where required.
* Supporting the planning and coordination of statutory services and inspections to ensure vessels maintain regulatory compliance.

**Technical Monitoring & Analysis**

* Monitor and review Fuel Oil Analysis reports and highlight abnormal trends where identified.
* Monitor and review Lube Oil Analysis reports and escalate potential technical risks.
* Monitor annual sample analysis for systems including Ballast Water, OWS, Sewage Treatment Plant, Potable Water, and Scrubber Water (EGCS).

**Technical Documentation & Reporting**

* Review Technical Month-End Returns submitted by vessels to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Review and circulate the Monthly Lube Oil (LO) Report to Accounts (TECH 06) in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate technical compliance records within company systems.

**Compliance Oversight & Verification**

* Conduct random reviews of Bunker Plans to verify compliance with company procedures.
* Conduct random reviews of Oil Record Book (Part I) entries to ensure proper documentation and regulatory compliance.

**Systems, Risk & Escalation**

* Utilize company systems including ShipSure, Technical Dashboards, Operational Risk Analysers, and VVP to monitor vessel compliance and identify potential technical risks.
* Escalate critical technical compliance gaps or statutory issues that may impact vessel safety, inspection outcomes, or regulatory compliance.
* Maintain records of monitoring activities and follow-up actions.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Support initiatives aimed at improving technical compliance, vessel reliability, and operational performance within the OSC.
* Promote consistent adherence to company procedures and technical standards across vessels.

**Additional Skills for Survey & Class Compliance Coordination (Specialist supporting AFSI Task)**

* Understanding of classification society survey cycles and statutory service requirements.
* Ability to coordinate with classification societies, surveyors, service providers, and ship management teams.
* Experience in tracking and planning vessel surveys, statutory inspections, and class compliance matters.
* Strong follow-up and documentation discipline to ensure timely closure of Conditions of Class (CoC) and survey-related actions.

**Key Interfaces**

* The Technical Compliance Specialist works closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure vessels maintain technical compliance and operational readiness.

**Internal Interfaces**

* Ship Managers / Fleet Managers
* Technical Superintendents
* Operations Support Centre (OSC) teams
* HSSEQ Department
* Marine Operations Team
* Accounts / Finance (for technical reporting such as LO reports)

**External Interfaces**

* Vessel Masters and Chief Engineers
* Classification Societies
* Oil analysis laboratories and technical service providers
* Surveyors and inspection bodies
* Equipment manufacturers and service technicians (where required)

**What can I expect in return?**
V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
  
  
**Essential**

* Relevant maritime technical or marine background with experience in ship operations, marine engineering, or technical fleet management with more than 2 years of experience.
* Strong understanding of planned maintenance systems (PMS) and vessel technical management processes.
* Familiarity with statutory, class, and regulatory requirements related to vessel operations.
* Ability to analyse technical reports and identify potential compliance gaps or operational risks.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple monitoring tasks simultaneously.
* Effective communication and coordination skills when working with ship management teams and internal stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications and technical reporting systems.

**Desirable**

* Sailing experience as a Marine Engineer (Class 3 COC & above) or Deck Officers (2nd Officer & above) with more than 1 year of experience.
* Prior experience in technical compliance monitoring, fleet technical support, or technical management offices.
* Familiarity with ShipSure or similar fleet management systems.
* Experience supporting class surveys, statutory inspections, and technical audits.

**Applications Close Date**

title: Subsidiary Governance Specialist

**What's The Role**
The individual will hold a Company Secretarial qualification or have a background as a corporate lawyer with at least five years company secretarial experience within a fast paced global or a highly matrixed multinational company. Confidentiality and discretion are critical due to the exposure to confidential information. This person will exhibit a natural confidence and strong presence, modelling the core values and expected behavior of the organisation and inspiring his/her colleagues to do the same. This position sits within the Global Subsidiary Governance Operations team, supporting company secretarial delivery for entities across multiple jurisdictions. Therefore, prior experience managing company secretarial requirements and completing corporate filings in many jurisdictions is critical. The individual will also need to demonstrate knowledge and/or experience of automation tools and leveraging data insights and technology in ways of working and process improvement. This is a truly global team, therefore, other language skills, in addition to English, are preferred.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Support the Directors of Shell entities.
* Support senior internal stakeholders with company secretarial matters and advising on internal governance procedures.

* Organise and conduct Board Meetings including drafting suitable proposals, collecting and distributing papers and agendas, producing minutes and communicating decisions to all those concerned with implementation/observance.
* Advise on Board papers and documentation requiring approval at Board Meetings and shareholder meetings (such as capital changes and company name changes) and other issues concerning company law and company secretarial practice.
* Maintain Action Items List from Board meetings and track completion of the actions.
* Act as corporate governance compliance officer charged with ensuring compliance by Shell entities globally with all statutory provisions.
* Advise on and prepare documents for company incorporations and process all formalities for incorporating new companies.
* Confident in the use of GEMS to ensure the production and filing in due time with local registries.
* Transactional and project support including providing support on company secretarial and company law aspects of planning projects, overseeing projects or initiatives regarding subsidiaries such as the legal entity management system.
* Ensuring proper records management for all decisions and associated documentation.

*General Matters*

* Manage junior team members and oversee their deliverables.
* Re-calibrating and reallocating workload as priorities change.
* Keep under review the broader Shell subsidiary governance processes, controls and ways of working within the Secretariat team; and keep under review Shell’s subsidiary management policies and frameworks and ensure that the subsidiaries for which s/he has responsibility are aligned with the other Group companies.
* Counsel Directors and other corporate secretariat team members on corporate governance regulations and practice and appropriate Group policies and procedures and the interpretation of constitutional documents and implementation of corporate procedures.
* Advise on Company Law affecting preparation of statutory accounts and reviewing statutory accounts for compliance and accuracy.
* Review Articles of Association and proposed changes thereto of new/existing subsidiary companies globally for acceptability/practicality.
* Keep up to date with regulatory changes in the corporate field and best practice movements in company secretarial practice with emphasis on appropriate developments in IT based solutions and the need to build knowledge management techniques.
* Deliver ad hoc corporate governance projects.
* Identifying and adopt new ways of working and implement new processes.

*Level of Authority (The scope of the role)*

* Liaising with Shell subsidiary Directors on various company boards.
* Acting as Company Secretary within the parameters set by the subsidiary boards of the companies for which s/he is responsible and liaising with the internal stakeholders for those subsidiaries, including business, compliance, finance and legal colleagues.
* The role requires communication with external parties such as local registries, Company Auditors, Third Party Law Firms, Third Party Banks and various Other Third-Party Bodies whether as part of a commercial transaction or in compliance with legislative requirements.

**What You Bring**

* Qualified Company Secretary (or equivalent) with a minimum of 5 years post qualification experience.
* Demonstrated track record in subsidiary management roles.
* Native or advanced level English skills is required.
* Other language skills, in addition to English, is preferred.
* Ability to effectively manage relationships with the key stakeholders relevant to the board (s) for which you have been allocated responsibility.
* Learning agility, conceptual thinker with problem solving and analytical capability.
* Proactive, forward thinking and innovative, well organised with the ability to work under pressure.
* Ability to balance inquiry and advocacy, with good stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Contextualizing and helping colleagues embrace change.
* Proven collaboration and project management skills.
* Adaptable to different cultures and working with diverse and virtual teams.
* Proven high delivery and project management capability.
* Experience of documenting processes and developing process manuals.
* Experience with automation and leveraging technology in ways of working and process improvement.
* Excellent planning and organisation skills, verbal and written skills, attention to detail and have the ability to work in a fast-paced, varied environment.

*Technical Skills*

description:
Job Title: Data Compliance & Governance Lead; Data Protection Officer (Global)
  
  
Job Location: Chennai, India
  
  
**Join Us!**
We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, the role leads global data governance, sets compliance and due diligence standards, and improves processes for data protection and responsible AI.
  
  
As Global Data Protection Officer (DPO), the role independently advises on and monitors privacy compliance, including but not limited to UK/EU GDPR and relevant US, Canadian, Saudi, Filipino and Indian laws, and acts as the contact for regulators and data subjects.

* Lead privacy incident response, from detection, containment and investigation to breach notification, regulatory engagement and lessons learned; coordinate remediation and control improvements.
* Manage vendor risks through due diligence, contracts, safeguards and monitoring; coordinate security controls with Security, Legal, Supply Chain Management and IT.
* Review and negotiate data processing agreements (DPAs) and relevant clauses
* Provide advice on data governance matters including data retention schedules
* Deliver tailored training, templates and playbooks; promote privacy-preserving techniques
* Maintain privacy notices, participate in AI transparency summaries and registers; report risks, incidents, remediation and governance benefits to leadership and communicate with stakeholders.

**Experience, Education And Other Required**

* 4+ years in privacy, compliance or governance, including leading global programmes in complex organisations.
* Strong knowledge of applicable privacy and AI laws, including but not limited UK/EU GDPR, EU AI Act
* Hands-on experience with international transfers, contractual risk, impact assessments, processing records and data subject rights.
* Experience in data and AI legal risk assessment, controls, assurance, audits, remediation and vendor risk programmes.
* Proven privacy leadership, including containment, notifications, control improvements and regulatory engagement.
* Ability to embed policies and training, report to senior stakeholders and manage global, regulatory and incident communications.
* Experience with implementing and managing a privacy management platform is a plus

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Law; Postgraduate or Master's degree advantageous.
* IAPP: Minimum of CIPP/E and CIPM.
* IAPP: AIGP certification required
* ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system) familiarity, qualifications in Information Security (e.g., ISO/IEC27001) and Project/Change Management (e.g. APMP, Prince) advantageous

**Additional Requirements**

* Ability to travel internationally as required.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures, geographies, and matrixed organizational structures.

* 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year.

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

title: Advocate
description:
**Company Description**
Chengalpattu District Court serves the Chengalpattu region as part of the broader judicial system in Tamil Nadu, India. The court handles a wide range of civil, criminal, and administrative matters, providing accessible legal services to individuals, businesses, and public entities. Advocates working with the court engage in diverse cases, gaining exposure to trial practice, procedural law, and substantive legal issues. The environment emphasizes integrity, adherence to legal ethics, and commitment to fair representation for all parties. It offers legal professionals opportunities to develop litigation expertise and contribute to the delivery of justice in the community.
  
**Role Description**
The Advocate will represent clients in matters before Chengalpattu District Court, handling case preparation, filing, and appearances in court on a full-time basis. Day-to-day responsibilities include drafting petitions, affidavits, written statements, and legal opinions, as well as reviewing case documents, evidence, and precedents. The role involves advising clients on legal rights and obligations, negotiating settlements where appropriate, and coordinating with court staff and other legal professionals to ensure timely progression of cases. The Advocate will conduct legal research, prepare arguments, and present oral submissions in hearings and trials. This is an on-site role based in Chennai, requiring regular presence in court and related offices.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of civil and criminal laws, procedural codes, and local court rules applicable to district court practice.
* Proficiency in drafting legal documents such as pleadings, petitions, affidavits, written arguments, and contracts.
* Capability in legal research using statutes, case law, commentaries, and online legal databases, with clear analysis and application to cases.
* Effective advocacy and negotiation skills, including confident oral presentation, examination of witnesses, and client counseling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Tamil is highly beneficial for client and court interactions.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities to handle multiple cases, deadlines, and court schedules responsibly.
* Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and impartiality, with a client-centered and service-oriented approach.
* LL.B. (Bachelor of Laws) from a recognized institution and valid enrollment with the Bar Council of Tamil Nadu or relevant Bar Council.
* Prior experience practicing in district courts or trial courts is preferred; motivated early-career advocates with internship or chamber experience are also encouraged to apply.

title: DPDP Data Privacy Lead
description:
We are expanding our DPDP delivery team for upcoming implementation engagements and are looking for Two Data Privacy Leads. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will personally carry out discovery, mapping, RoPA and DPIA work, and you will lead the engagement end to end – from scoping through to hardening, consent and incident-readiness deliverables.

**Engagement Snapshot:**

**Role -**
**Data Privacy Lead (DPDP)**

**Engagement type - Contract**

6-month rolling; extension subject to project waves and performance

**Experience**

8–12 years overall, with at least 4 years in data privacy / data protection

**Location**

One position is based in Chennai and the Second position is based in Bengauru. Local candidates preferred.

Mostly On-site with some hybrid

**Reporting to**

Engagement Lead / Project Partner, PTS Consulting LLP

**Start**

November 1st Week; start date to be confirmed with shortlisted candidates

**Key Responsibilities:**

The Data Privacy Lead will be expected to perform the following personally and to a consulting-deliverable standard.

•    
**Process map review.**
Review business process maps and SIPOC documentation, identify where personal data is collected, used, shared, stored and disposed of, and validate findings with process owners.

•    
**Data discovery and classification.**
Independently plan and run data discovery across applications, databases, file shares and collaboration tools; classify personal data elements by category and sensitivity, using discovery tooling and manual techniques.

•    
**Data-to-process mapping and DPDP scope.**
Map discovered data to business processes and activities, and clearly articulate the scope of DPDP coverage for each activity – including applicability, legal basis, exemptions and the roles of data fiduciary and data processor.

•    
**Record of Processing Activities (RoPA).**
Prepare and maintain a complete, defensible RoPA linked to processes, systems, data elements, purposes, retention and third-party sharing.

•    
**DPIA and hardening.**
Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments, and oversee the resulting privacy hardening and security hardening work – tracking recommendations, owners and closure through to verified completion.

•    
**Consent management.**
Oversee consent management design and rollout – notices, purpose-wise consent, preference and withdrawal handling, and records of consent – working with legal, product and technology teams.

•    
**Incident response and breach notification.**
Manage the personal data breach response lifecycle: triage, containment, assessment, notification to the Data Protection Board and affected Data Principals as required, and post-incident corrective action.

•    
**Engagement leadership.**
Lead the engagement team, own the work plan and quality of deliverables, and manage client stakeholders up to senior leadership.

**What we are looking for:**

**Essential:**

•    8–12 years of overall experience, including 4 or more years of hands-on data privacy or data protection delivery (DPDP Act).

•    Demonstrated, in-depth experience in every one of the responsibilities listed above – not a subset. You should be able to describe what you personally did on each.

•    Experience of independently running data discovery and classification and translating the output into process-level scope and a RoPA.

•    Experience of conducting DPIAs and taking the outcomes through to implemented privacy and security controls.

•    Practical experience of consent management and of handling a personal data breach including regulator and individual notification.

•    Proven record of leading a privacy engagement successfully with client leadership, a delivery team and defined deadlines.

•    Clear, structured written and verbal communication; strong, well-organised documentation.

**Preferred / nice to Have:**

•    Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, DCPP (DSCI), ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or Implementer, ISO/IEC 27701, CISA or CISSP.

•    Familiarity with data discovery, consent management or privacy management platforms.

•    Exposure to multi-entity corporate groups and to manufacturing, healthcare, financial services, technology or consumer-facing businesses.

•    Working knowledge of information security controls (access control, encryption, logging, retention and disposal).

**A note on Fit**

This is a delivery role. We are looking for practitioners who have done the work themselves. Candidates whose experience is primarily in policy drafting, awareness training or advisory review without hands-on discovery, mapping and assessment work may find the role is not the right fit.

**How to express Interest:**

Please send your CV and a short note (half a page) describing one privacy engagement in which you personally carried out data discovery, RoPA preparation and a DPIA, and what your role was in leading it.

[insert application email / LinkedIn application link]

* Extensive working knowledge of operational risk & control processes and practices, including experience in their application across functions.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Chennai office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
  
  
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
  
  
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Risk & Compliance Transformation

+ Support the assessment, design, and implementation of risk, compliance, and governance frameworks.
+ Work with clients to improve monitoring, controls, reporting, and regulatory compliance processes.
+ Assist in identifying opportunities for process optimization, automation, and control enhancement.
+ Support transformation initiatives related to risk management, compliance monitoring, operational risk, governance, and internal controls.

**Business Analysis & Solution Delivery**




+ Gather business requirements through workshops, interviews, and stakeholder discussions.
+ Develop business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories, and process maps.
+ Perform current-state and target-state assessments and identify transformation opportunities.
+ Support end-to-end project delivery including requirements management, testing, deployment, and change management.

**Technology & Digital Transformation**




+ Collaborate with technology teams to implement workflow, governance, compliance, and risk management solutions.
+ Evaluate and recommend technology-enabled solutions to address business and regulatory challenges.
+ Support implementation of GRC, risk management, compliance monitoring, workflow, and reporting platforms.
+ Leverage data analytics and dashboarding to improve decision-making and governance reporting.

**AI & Emerging Technology**




+ Help clients identify and prioritize AI, GenAI, and intelligent automation use cases across risk and compliance functions.
+ Support development of AI-enabled solutions for regulatory intelligence, policy management, document review, reporting, and knowledge management.
+ Assist in defining business requirements, governance considerations, and adoption strategies for AI-driven initiatives.
+ Evaluate opportunities to enhance risk and compliance processes through automation, predictive insights, and advanced analytics.

**Stakeholder & Project Management**




+ Work closely with client stakeholders across Risk, Compliance, Technology, Operations, and Business functions.
+ Support project governance, status reporting, issue tracking, and executive presentations.
+ Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 4-6 years of experience in Risk Consulting, Compliance, Business Analysis, Technology Transformation, Banking, Financial Services, or related domains.
* Experience in regulatory, compliance, governance, risk, or transformation initiatives.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Data Privacy Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**

The Privacy Specialist is responsible for supporting and strengthening the organization’s privacy and personal data protection program, with strong working knowledge of India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and applicable rules. The role focuses on privacy compliance, data handling practices, risk assessments, documentation, individual rights requests, and coordination with business and technical teams. Experience with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**DPDP Compliance & Privacy Governance**

* Maintain and support the organization’s privacy program in alignment with India’s DPDP Act and applicable rules and guidance
* Translate privacy obligations into practical policies, procedures, workflows, and controls for relevant business functions
* Support privacy governance activities, maintain compliance registers, and track implementation of privacy requirements
* Monitor changes in privacy laws, rules, and regulatory guidance and assess their potential impact on organizational practices

**Personal Data Lifecycle & Data Principal Rights**

* Support data mapping and records of personal data processing, including collection, use, sharing, retention, and deletion
* Help establish and maintain processes for handling data principal requests, grievances, consent withdrawal, and related communications, as applicable
* Review privacy notices, consent language, and data collection forms to help ensure transparency and appropriate purpose limitation
* Coordinate with business and technical teams to support retention schedules, deletion processes, and appropriate handling of personal data

**Privacy Risk Assessments & Incident Management**

* Conduct or coordinate privacy impact and risk assessments for new projects, products, vendors, and changes to personal data processing
* Identify privacy risks and recommend proportionate controls and remediation actions in collaboration with relevant teams
* Support the identification, assessment, escalation, and documentation of personal data breaches and privacy incidents
* Coordinate with Security, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders on incident response, required assessments, and applicable notification obligations

**Third-Party Privacy & GDPR (Added Advantage)**

* Review vendor and partner privacy practices, contractual clauses, and data-processing arrangements with relevant stakeholders
* Support privacy due diligence and track remediation of issues identified during vendor reviews or assessments
* Where applicable, assist with GDPR-related activities such as data subject rights, lawful bases, records of processing, and cross-border transfer reviews
* Help map privacy requirements across jurisdictions and identify common controls while accounting for jurisdiction-specific obligations

**Documentation, Training & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain privacy policies, procedures, notices, assessment records, processing registers, and evidence of compliance
* Prepare privacy compliance updates, risk summaries, metrics, and reports for management and internal stakeholders
* Deliver or coordinate privacy awareness sessions and provide practical guidance to teams handling personal data

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–8 years of experience in data privacy, privacy compliance, information security GRC, legal compliance, or a related role
* Strong, demonstrable knowledge of India’s DPDP Act and applicable rules, including key obligations relating to notice, consent where applicable, data principal rights, safeguards, breach response, and accountability
* Experience with privacy documentation, data mapping, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and coordination with cross-functional stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field; relevant privacy or data protection experience may also be considered
* Working experience with DPDP, GDPR is an added advantage; certifications or training such as CIPP/A, CIPP/E, CIPM, or other relevant privacy qualifications are desirable
* Experience managing security incidents and crisis situations
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, or related field

Certifications such as ( Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) - Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) - Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE ), CDPO or ISO/IEC 27701.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Compliance Specialist**

**Experience: 3–8 years**

**Location: Chennai and Bangalore**

**Role Overview**

The Compliance Specialist is responsible for supporting and managing the organization’s information security, privacy, and regulatory compliance activities. The role focuses on maintaining management system documentation, coordinating audits and assessments, tracking corrective actions, and helping ensure alignment with applicable standards and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**ISMS & Governance**

* Maintain and continually improve the Information Security Management System (ISMS), including policies, procedures, controls, and records
* Coordinate risk assessments, risk treatment plans, Statement of Applicability (SoA), and management review activities
* Maintain compliance registers, control matrices, evidence repositories, and documented information
* Support security awareness initiatives and communicate compliance requirements to relevant stakeholders

**Standards & Regulatory Compliance**

* Support implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of ISO/IEC 27001-based ISMS requirements
* Demonstrate working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001 requirements for an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS), including AI governance and risk management
* Coordinate compliance activities for PCI DSS and SOC 2, including control mapping, evidence collection, gap assessments, and remediation tracking
* Interpret applicable contractual, regulatory, and customer security requirements and map them to internal controls

**Audit & Assessment Management**

* Coordinate internal audits, external certification audits, surveillance audits, and customer assessments
* Prepare audit plans, evidence packs, control narratives, and supporting documentation
* Track nonconformities, observations, risks, and corrective and preventive actions through closure
* Work with control owners to validate evidence, address audit findings, and demonstrate control effectiveness

**Risk Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify compliance gaps and assess risks related to information security, privacy, AI governance, and applicable standards
* Maintain risk registers, corrective action plans, compliance calendars, and periodic review records
* Monitor changes to standards and regulatory requirements and assess their impact on organizational controls
* Recommend practical improvements to strengthen governance, documentation, and control maturity

**Stakeholder & Reporting Management**

* Collaborate with IT, security, HR, legal, engineering, and business teams to implement and evidence controls
* Prepare compliance status reports, audit updates, risk summaries, and management review inputs
* Act as a coordination point for auditors, customers, and internal stakeholders on compliance-related matters

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–8 years of experience in information security compliance, GRC, audit, risk management, or a related role
* Practical experience with ISMS and strong working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001; knowledge or experience with ISO/IEC 42001, PCI DSS, and SOC 2 is required
* Experience in audit coordination, evidence preparation, gap assessments, control mapping, and remediation tracking

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field
* Relevant certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, ISO/IEC 42001, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CDPSE or PCI DSS-related qualifications
* Experience managing security incidents and crisis situations
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills

Background
  
  
The Chennai Regulatory Compliance team supports compliance activities for Corpay Cross-Border across regions. Role Summary
  
  
The Regulatory Compliance Analyst will work from Chennai and align to Toronto business hours. The analyst will monitor the LEI case queue, action new registration, renewal, transfer and update requests, and maintain clear evidence of work performed. The role requires regular communication with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, obtain documentation and escalate matters that require guidance from the Compliance Director or the North America regulatory compliance team.

* Monitor the assigned LEI case queue daily and prioritize cases in line with agreed service levels, procedures and business urgency.

* Good written and verbal communication skills, especially for stakeholder follow-ups, documentation requests and exception summaries.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including filters, lookups, reconciliations and basic reporting.

**Job Title: Company Secretary**
**Role Purpose**
 The Company Secretary will provide end‑to‑end corporate governance, statutory compliance, and board‑support services for the company’s Indian entities. The role ensures that all corporate records, filings, and governance processes meet applicable legal, regulatory, and internal standards. The position requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work closely with senior leadership across Legal, Finance, HR, and Operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Corporate Governance \& Board Support**
* Manage board and committee meetings, including scheduling, agenda preparation, circulation of papers, and minute‑taking.
* Maintain statutory registers, corporate records, and entity‑level documentation in accordance with the Companies Act and internal governance frameworks.
* Ensure timely execution, notarisation, apostille, and safe custody of corporate documents.
* Support directors with governance queries, declarations, and compliance requirements.


**Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Prepare and file statutory returns with the Registrar of Companies and other authorities (MCA, RBI, etc.).
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure the company remains compliant with all applicable laws.
* Coordinate annual filings, board resolutions, shareholder resolutions, and event‑based filings.
* Liaise with external regulators, auditors, and advisors as required.


**Entity Management \& Corporate Actions**
* Maintain the corporate database and ensure entity information is accurate and up to date.
* Support incorporations, amendments, director appointments/removals, share transfers, and other corporate actions.
* Draft and review board resolutions, powers of attorney, and governance documents.


**Internal Coordination \& Support**
* Work closely with Legal, Finance, HR, and Operations to ensure governance requirements are embedded in business processes.
* Support internal audits, compliance reviews, and group governance initiatives.
* Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on governance standards and statutory obligations.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI) with 3–7 years of post‑qualification experience.
* Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, MCA processes, and corporate governance best practices.
* Experience managing multiple entities within a group structure is preferred.
* Excellent drafting, minute‑taking, and organisational skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and interact confidently with senior stakeholders.
* High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism.


**Personal Attributes**
* Detail‑oriented with strong ownership and accountability.
* Proactive, organised, and able to manage competing priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work across functions and jurisdictions.


 Additional Information

title: Associate Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world’s top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we’re growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!
   

  

 CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.
   

  

 We currently have an exciting career opportunity for an
 **Associate** 
**Manager** 
 to join the
 **PMT** 
 team in
 **Hyderabad** 
 office.
   

  

 CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered hybrid which means team members are expected to be thoughtful and intentional in how they create opportunities for in\-person collaboration. While the cadence of in\-office presence is determined at the team level, our professionals are encouraged to be in the office/together in person on average 2 days a week for purposes of team building and anticipated assistance and supervision for a junior attorney.
   

  

**YOUR TEAM.**
 T his position will support our Advisory team. This role involves attorney providing review of non\-disclosure agreements, marketing agreements, business associate agreements, data processing agreements, requests for proposals (including government solicitations for services), certificates of insurance and client questionnaires, and provide assistance with subpoenas.
   

  

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**
 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
* The successful candidate will be hired by CohnReznick Professional Services Private Limited to assist CohnReznick Advisory LLC’s fast\-paced Legal Department located in the US with review of client and vendor agreements, including master service and engagement agreements, non disclosure agreements, business associate agreements and data processing agreements to identify risk considerations and exposures.
* Interface with and support members of the CohnReznick Advisory LLC Legal Department in handling such matters.
* Ability to balance legal considerations with practical business needs.
* Assist with Legal Department projects, including subpoenas, and potential litigation or M\&A support depending on experience.


**Your Experience.**
**The successful candidate will have:**
* A successful Bachelors or master’s in law from a BCI recognized college/ University.
* Preferred candidate has 8\-12 years of relevant experience.
* Prior experience providing legal support to a US\-based professional services firm and understanding/experience of US legal concepts strongly preferred. Law firm or in\-house experience preferred.
* Ability to navigate and advise on complex legal issues and provide straightforward, practical analysis and advice.
* Exceptional advocacy, negotiation, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work closely and collaboratively with our CohnReznick Advisory LLC Legal team.
* Highly organized, self\-motivated and self\-directed. Candidate needs to be able to work efficiently, with varying degrees of supervision, and manage projects with competing deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Ability to work with technology platforms such as contract management platforms to support legal and contracting operations a plus.


 In addition, please take a moment to review our
 **Universal Job Standards.**
 Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.
   

  

 "CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms.
   

  

 CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Assistant Vice President – Sanctions and Embargoes, Level A
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Assistant Vice President – Sanctions and Embargoes, Level A
   

  

**Department** 
 : India CoE Compliance Hub
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 India CoE Compliance Hub enables safeguarding the Group’s reputation and mitigating the risks across all business lines by supporting the Compliance functions globally. Currently, the India CoE Hub is structured into divisions aligned with the areas they serve, offering services for Group Compliance COO TOP, trade surveillance, electronic communications monitoring, transversal risk management, personal account dealing, MIS, and project support. The team collaborates closely with business partners worldwide.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The Sanctions and Embargoes Level A Team Leader's role is to lead a Level A Sanctions \& Embargoes team. Level A Sanctions \& Embargoes Teams perform the first, quick triage of alerts produced by the Group’s Sanctions \& Embargoes payments filtering system. Level A Analyst must recognise obvious false hits and release the payments linked to these, escalating other alerts to Level B1 teams for further analysis and investigation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ensure that the team delivers a timely and accurate delivery of analysis by ensuring alerts are correctly prioritised, promptly reviewed, correctly analysed and the right drop\-down menu decisions selected.
* Provide guidance to team members faced with novel and unclear situations in the analysis of alerts.
* Ensure the timely and effective recruitment of team members by pushing forward all stakeholders in the recruitment and onboarding process, selecting candidates judiciously and ensuring a smooth onboarding process for new\-joiners.
* Ensure the proper training of newcomers by organising the training plan.
* Act as a role model to team members in contributing to transversal topics (e.g. sharing of best practice across the Compliance Hub).
* Motivate the Team to contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and tools by encouraging them to identify and measure process inefficiencies or tool deficiencies, escalating these so that proposed changes can be assessed and sharing bet practice with other Compliance Hub Teams.
* Ensure that the teams have the appropriate level of competence, by organising, with Global team, training of new recruits, making sure that the team members have a good understanding of their duties and of the procedures and decision grids, and that the team undertake the training programmes
* Manage communication with GFS by relaying instructions from Global teams to the local team, ensuring these are well understood and informing Global Teams of anything relevant regarding the local team and the activity.
* Contribute to and follow up on quality assurance actions according to the control framework.
* By assessing performance regularly and providing recommendations on compensation and objectives.

* Decision Making
* Organisational skills
* Ability to develop and adapt a process
* Ability to deliver/Results driven
* Ability to share/pass on knowledge

 10\+years’ experience in banking \& Financial operations covering successful projects planning and delivery preferably in Compliance or Financial domains.

title: Regulatory Risk Officer - Vice President
description:
The Regulatory Risk Officer is responsible for driving customer remediation analytics to completion including execution and validation. This position will be part of the USCC Centralized Customer Remediation Team (CCRT). The objective of the USCC CCRT is to quickly assess and identify customer impacts and ensure remediation is completed promptly with the appropriate detailed documentation required by Internal Audit and the Regulators. These activities will be conducted in close partnership with the Issue Owners and Managers within U.S. Consumer Cards. Excellent communication skills are required to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Highly developed communication and diplomacy skills are required, to guide, influence, and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. This role is for an individual contributor SME.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Subject matter expert related to data analytics and remediation methodology. May train, mentor, and coach lower\-level staff,
* Owns, designs, and manages client remediation population and impact analyses for USCC owned and impacted issues, including those that are Regulatory.
* 
* Provide expertise and guidance related to the USCC remediation processes and policies, partners with other department leaders to define, prioritize, and execute remediation programs.
